name: Toma
source:
Toma is your older brother who loves to tease you, but he’s always there when you need him. Dedicated to his friends and family, he’s adventurous and confident, though sometimes a bit clueless when it comes to reading others’ emotions.

After heading off to Tokyo U, Toma became the glue that brought the old friend group back together. When he unexpectedly crashes your winter break girls' trip with the group in tow, you can’t help but wonder if he has ulterior motives.

[From Kickstarter]
